description: Find web features by plain name or keyword when the canonical key is unknown, across CSS, JavaScript, HTML, Web APIs, SVG, MathML, WebAssembly, and HTTP headers. Returns ranked matches with the BCD key, the web-features id, the Baseline state, a one-line support summary, and which field matched. Feed a result key into browsercompat_get_feature for the full record.

baseline.description: Restrict results to one Baseline state.

group.description: Restrict results to features in one web-features group or any group nested under it, for example "selectors" or "css". Keys with no web-features mapping never match. Call browsercompat_list_reference with topic groups for valid ids.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 50.

namespace.description: Restrict results to one top-level browser-compat-data namespace.

offset.description: Number of ranked matches to skip before returning results, for paging past limit. Pass the nextOffset from the previous response.

query.description: Plain-language name, keyword, or code notation, for example "container query", "fromAsync", "Array.prototype.at", "display: grid", or "<dialog>".

snapshot.description: Restrict results to features in one ECMAScript snapshot, for example "ecmascript-2023". Call browsercompat_list_reference with topic snapshots for valid ids.

name: browsercompat_search_features

appliedFilters.description: Filters the server applied to this search.

group.description: web-features group filter the search applied, nested groups included.

snapshot.description: ECMAScript snapshot filter the search applied.

data_version.description: Vintage of each bundled dataset behind this answer.

bcd_generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the browser-compat-data snapshot was generated at.

browserslist.description: Version of the bundled browserslist query resolver.

caniuse_lite.description: Version of the bundled caniuse-lite snapshot.

web_features.description: Version of the bundled web-features snapshot.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_query`: query is whitespace-only after normalization, or normalizes to zero tokens. `unknown_group`: group names no web-features group in the bundled data. `unknown_snapshot`: snapshot names no ECMAScript snapshot in the bundled data. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page. Present only while matches remain past this page.

noMatchNotice.description: How to broaden a search that matched nothing.

offsetNotice.description: Why a page came back empty although the search matched.

results.description: Ranked matches, best first. An empty array is a successful search with no hits.

baseline_state.description: Baseline state for this entry, reported per browser-compat-data key.

bcd_key.description: browser-compat-data key. Absent for entries that own no compat keys.

matched_on.description: Which field matched the query, so the ranking can be inspected. path_suffix means the key ends in the dotted or property-value notation the query used, such as Element.animate or display: grid.

mdn_url.description: MDN reference page for this key.

support_summary.description: One line over the Baseline core browsers, with — for unsupported and ? for unknown.

shown.description: Number of results on this page.

totalCount.description: Matches across every page, before offset and limit apply.

truncated.description: True when more matches remain past this page.

title: Browsercompat Search Features
